label: Guided pathways (statewide)
lever: Structured degree maps, default course sequences and meta-majors adopted statewide

label: "15 to Finish" campaign
lever: Statewide campaign urging full-time loads of 15 credits a term

label: Excess credit-hour surcharge
lever: Higher tuition, or no state funding, for credits above 110-150% of degree requirements

label: Transferable general-education core
lever: A lower-division general-education block every public institution must accept

label: Common course numbering
lever: Shared course numbers for equivalent courses across public institutions

label: Guaranteed associate-degree transfer
lever: An associate degree satisfies general education and/or brings junior standing

label: Reverse transfer
lever: University credits sent back so the community college can award an associate degree

label: Transferable credit package
lever: A certificate or transcript notation for a completed general-education block

label: Dual-enrollment funding
lever: State pays, waives or caps tuition for high-school students taking college courses

label: AP credit mandate
lever: Public institutions must award credit for qualifying AP scores, usually 3
